title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by learning the token-level discrepancy between a stronger teacher and an on-policy student. However, this discrepancy does not purely reflect the capability gap between the teacher and the student: it also contains deviations arising from the teacher itself, which are consequently mixed into the observed teacher--student discrepancy and indiscriminately learned by standard OPD during training. This issue is further exacerbated by privileged OPD, where privileged information induces larger teacher-side likelihood shifts, thereby encouraging the student to learn more of the teacher's own deviation. We introduce \textbf{Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (Cal-OPD)}, which estimates the teacher's self-deviation region through positive and negative privileged interventions and calibrates the original teacher--student discrepancy by retaining only the component that lies beyond this region

translated_title: 面向在线策略蒸馏的师生差异校准
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏通过学习更强教师模型与在线策略学生模型之间的词元级差异来改进推理模型。然而，这种差异并不纯粹反映师生之间的能力差距：它还包含教师自身产生的偏差，这些偏差因此混入所观测到的师生差异中，并被标准OPD在训练过程中不加区分地学习。这一问题在特权OPD中进一步加剧，其中特权信息会引起更大的教师侧似然偏移，从而促使学生学习更多教师自身的偏差。我们提出了校准在线策略蒸馏，它通过正向和负向特权干预来估计教师的自我偏差区域，并通过仅保留位于该区域之外的分量来校准原始的师生差异。
tldr: 提出Cal-OPD方法，通过正负特权干预估计教师自身的偏差区域并据此校准师生差异，使学生只学习真正的师生能力差距而非教师自身的偏差。
en_tdlr: Cal-OPD estimates the teacher's self-deviation region through positive and negative privileged interventions and calibrates the teacher-student discrepancy, so that the student learns only the true capability gap rather than the teacher's own deviations.
